Nina: FYI we got two failed attempts from NimbusLabs (acct NL-412) on today's autopay run. Card ending 3012 declined → then token retry failed with network_error. They emailed saying treasury wants to wire today.
Owen: Can you drop invoice numbers and amounts? I'll generate a one-time wire template and flip the account to manual collect.
Nina: INV-5562 $3,750 and INV-5563 $6,500. Total $10,250. Billing contact is treasury@nimbuslabs.io (Adam). He prefers wire but will accept ACH if we can provide an instant paylink.
PaymentsBot: [auto] Attempt 2026-04-02T08:03:12Z INV-5562 -> card_declined_code:insufficient_funds. Retry 2026-04-02T08:10:33Z -> network_error.
Rae: I can approve manual wire release up to $15k. We need a signed wire authorisation + either a bank statement or bank letter for beneficiary verification before posting. @Chris-ops can confirm process time.
Chris-ops: I can verify within 1-3 hours if docs received during business hours. Requirements: bank letter on letterhead OR statement showing account number and company name that matches invoice entity. Also need contact at bank + phone number.
Nina: I'll draft note to Adam with both options: ACH paylink + wire form. Also will pause auto-cancels and set grace flag so subscription doesn't drop.
Owen: Wire block to give customer:
```
Bank: Summit National Bank
Routing/ABA: 222000111
Account: 123456789
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
SWIFT: SNBKUS44
Reference: INV-5562 / NimbusLabs
Address: 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
```
Rae: Also include instruction: "Please attach signed wire authorization and bank letter/statement when replying." Once docs are verified, send screenshot of verification to me and I'll finalize posting.
Nina: Sending message now: "Hi Adam — apologies for the failed attempts. For fastest processing you can either use this secure ACH link: https://pay.redwood.com/pay/NL-XXXXXX (one-time) or wire to the details attached. If wiring, please attach a signed authorization + bank letter/statement and reply to this thread so we can verify and post today."

Adam (via email, copied by Nina): "Sending bank letter now, should arrive in ~20 min."
Chris-ops: Great. When the letter lands, route to me and I'll run beneficiary verification. If the names mismatch, escalate to compliance.
Owen: I'll prepare an internal quicksheet to record the wire once posted and mark invoices pending in billing. Also will note reconciliation code: BANK-WIRE-POST.
Rae: If they ask for payment via payment link but want net 30 terms, flag for AR review. We don't auto-extend net terms without approvals.
